_README: CLINICIAN-SUPPLIED titration thresholds (Kristen review themes T1/T4/T5/T8). SHIPS as a documented SHAPE here; the active values live in titration_thresholds.json (preferred when present). These are clinical thresholds and must be confirmed by the PI (NEEDS_PI_SIGNOFF.md). Duration is expressed as DURATION_RANK from engine_core.snapshot (under_31s=1, 31s_2min=2, 2_5min=3, over_5min=4). Loaded by engine_core.titration_config.load_thresholds().

escalate_faster._doc: Breakthrough seizures that warrant a FASTER increase (rather than continuing the standard plan).

continue_ok._doc: Breakthrough that is acceptable to keep titrating through (no faster increase needed).

switch_when_not_helpful._doc: When the current med is not helping, minimum time on it before considering a switch.

lamotrigine_small_rash_workup._doc: Any TRUE -> switch a small/non-spreading rash on an SJS-risk drug (theme T11).
lamotrigine_small_rash_workup._switch_if_on_known_sjs_risk_comed_doc: On another medication independently linked to SJS/TEN: antibiotics (esp. sulfonamides, penicillins, cephalosporins), NSAIDs, or allopurinol.
